# Techplus.pk

> Pakistan's authentic supplier of 100% pure copper motor power tools, electric drill to chainsaw converters, cordless drill kits, and verified engineering & appliance maintenance services in Islamabad & Rawalpindi.

## About Techplus.pk
Techplus.pk is an engineering and machinery supplier serving contractors, craftspeople, auto workshops, and homeowners across Pakistan. Founded with 20+ years of electrical engineering legacy in Islamabad and offering turnkey solar EPC installation since 2018, every product and service adheres to rigorous quality standards and regional voltage resilience.

## Product Departments & Direct Links
- [Chainsaw & Reciprocating Converters](https://techplus.pk/shop/tool-converters): Drill-to-chainsaw adapter kits (4-inch, 6-inch, angle grinder rods) starting from Rs. 2,499.
- [Cordless Power Tools](https://techplus.pk/shop/cordless-power-tools): 18V and 21V lithium-ion cordless drills, impact wrenches, and dual-battery toolkits.
- [Heavy Duty Electric Drills](https://techplus.pk/shop/drill-machines): 710W to 960W pure copper armature impact drills, rotary hammer machines, and screwdriver drills.
- [Polishers, Cutters & Pliers](https://techplus.pk/shop/hand-tools): Multifunctional wire strippers, miter shears, high-torque pliers, and rotary cutters.
- [Complete Machinery Catalog](https://techplus.pk/shop): Full searchable inventory with live pricing and stock availability.

## Technical & Engineering Services
- [OUR SERVICES](https://techplus.pk/services): Complete doorstep technical services in Islamabad & Rawalpindi.
  1. **Solar System Installation**: Turnkey on-grid, off-grid, and hybrid solar installations since 2018 with complete IESCO net-metering approval.
  2. **Electrical Services**: 20+ years of wide experience in house rewiring, DB box load balancing, and 24/7 short-circuit troubleshooting.
  3. **Air Conditioning**: High-pressure chemical jet deep wash, genuine R410A/R32 gas refills, and inverter PCB diagnostics.
  4. **Plumbing Services & Core Cutting**: Sanitary fittings, PPRC pipeline pressure testing, and precision diamond core cutting (2" to 8").
  5. **CCTV & Biometric Time Attendance**: Hikvision & Dahua HD/IP cameras with mobile streaming and biometric face/fingerprint attendance.
  6. **PABX & Computer Networking**: Cat6 structured cabling, server rack installations, TP-Link access points, and office intercoms.
  7. **Fire Alarm System**: Optical smoke detectors, thermal heat sensors, break-glass call points, and central alarm panels.
- [Our Repair Services (We Repair)](https://techplus.pk/services#book-service): Doorstep appliance repairs including AC, Cloth Iron, Refrigerator, Room Cooler, Fan, Washing Machine, Clothes Dryer, Microwave Oven, Geyser, and Vacuum Cleaner.
